theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  profile_tactic "unfolds" in unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  profile_tactic "unfolds2" in unfold hammingClose
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_is := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  have hpos : 0 < d_i := Nat.succ_pos _
  profile_tactic "hsb" in have hsb : ∀ a : ℕ, ↑i + steps ≤ a → a - (↑i + steps) + steps = a - ↑i := by
    intro a ha
    rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev _ _ _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _) ha, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  profile_tactic "halg" in have halg : (d_is - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [d_is, d_i, BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add,
      hsb _ (Nat.le_trans h_i_add_steps (Nat.le_add_right _ _)), hsb _ h_i_add_steps]
  profile_tactic "obtain" in obtain ⟨g', hg', hmin⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i,
      d_fw = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    have hne : Set.Nonempty ((fun (g : C_i) =>
        (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ) :=
      Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty
    rcases Nat.sInf_mem hne with ⟨w, _, hw⟩
    exact ⟨w, w.property, hw.symm⟩
  have hcount : hammingDist f g' ≤
      (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    profile_tactic "sets" in set q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
    profile_tactic "sets2" in set s := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x)
    profile_tactic "sets3" in set Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    profile_tactic "showmul" in show s.card ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps
    profile_tactic "showmul2" in rw [mul_comm]
    profile_tactic "refine" in refine (Finset.card_le_mul_card_image (f := q) s (2 ^ steps) fun b _ => ?_).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 ^ steps) ?_)
    · profile_tactic "b1hsub" in have hsub : s.filter (fun a => q a = b) ⊆
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))).image fun k =>
            qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
              (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (y := b) k := by
        intro x hx
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
            (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x), Finset.mem_univ _,
          (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := x) (y := b)).mp
            (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2.symm⟩
      profile_tactic "b1fin" in exact Nat.le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub)
        (Finset.card_image_le.trans (by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]))
    · profile_tactic "b2" in rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset]
      refine Set.ncard_le_ncard ?_
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
      exact ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩
  profile_tactic "hbridge" in have hbridge : Δ₀(f, ↑C_i) ≤ ↑(d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := by
    refine le_trans (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g' hg') ?_
    rw [hmin]
    exact ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr hcount
  profile_tactic "hnat" in have hnat : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← halg]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  profile_tactic "h2" in have h2 : (2 : ℕ∞) * Δ₀(f, ↑C_i) ≤ ↑(2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps)) :=
    (mul_le_mul_left' hbridge 2).trans ((ENat.coe_mul _ _).symm).le
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt h2 (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_of_le_pred hpos hnat))
